verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure for AI agents, so a built-in assistant is a fair question, but the evidence shows no first-party AI assistant inside the product that a user can hand tasks to. What it does document are integrations and skills that let external agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini Computer Use, CrewAI, Browser-Use, etc.) drive Steel browsers. Those are developer building blocks and third-party agent hookups, not an in-product assistant.
